name: session-meter
description: Progress bar above the prompt driven by Claude's own task list, plus a session panel (/session-meter) with cost, tokens, context and time for the main loop and every subagent.

language.title: Language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale

band.title: Progress bar
band.description: auto: shown while there is a task list or subagents; always: also a cost line when idle; off: never

prices.title: Price overrides
prices.description: USD per million tokens, checked before the built-in table: 'pattern=input/output/cacheRead/cacheWrite; ...', e.g. 'opus-5-5=4/20/0.2/5'
